answer: Give every identity a bandwidth quota: each epoch it must relay a slice of gossip traffic through its own network path, verified by neighbours measuring arrival times. A vine of relays only trusts traffic arriving through a separate connection, so one pipe cannot feed many mouths. A Sybil operator's fakes share the same link, so per-identity throughput collapses, and the ivory-tower attack — thousands of identities on one cheap server — starves in the tundra of its own congestion: each extra fake needs its own paid, uncongested pipe, and the cost grows with every fake, never amortized.
